content_blocks.title: Common pitfall
content_blocks.text: Do not treat a syntactically plausible example as proof of correctness. For building user interfaces, check the input type, missing/empty cases, output shape, and domain assumptions.

common_mistakes.problem: Assuming inputs are valid because the UI restricts the normal interaction.
common_mistakes.why: Requests, empty states and malformed values can still reach server logic.
common_mistakes.fix: Validate input in server-side code and display clear recoverable errors.

common_mistakes.problem: Putting too much state into one reactive expression.
common_mistakes.why: Hidden dependencies make updates difficult to reason about and test.
common_mistakes.fix: Keep calculations focused and make reactive dependencies explicit.

common_mistakes.problem: Displaying private data without checking who may access it.
common_mistakes.why: A reactive output can expose records if authorization is not checked.
common_mistakes.fix: Apply server-side authorization and test denied-access cases.
